inputLabel: Song link, search, or local media
inputPlaceholder: Paste a URL, or type a song name to search

advanced.commandPlaceholder: Enter input to preview the CLI command.
advanced.logsPlaceholder: Logs will stream here while a job is running.

search.unifiedHint: Looks like a song name — searching YouTube and Bilibili together.
search.resultsHint: YouTube + Bilibili · clips under {{minutes}} min ranked first
search.karaokeSplitWarning: Karaoke uploads often already remove the lead vocal. Creating backing again may not improve the result; turn off backing bias when you need the original vocal for transcription.
search.noResults: No videos matched. Try different keywords.
search.failedBoth: YouTube and Bilibili search both failed.

authRequired.title: Sign-in required
authRequired.body: The site needs cookies. Open desktop options, paste browser cookies, then retry.

noCaptions.title: No captions found
noCaptions.body: Switch to local transcription to generate subtitles from the audio.

rateLimited.title: Rate limited
rateLimited.body: Wait a few minutes before retrying, or try a different language.

hfRateLimited.title: HuggingFace rate limit
hfRateLimited.body: Anonymous downloads from huggingface.co are throttled. Paste an HF token in Settings to lift the limit, or set a mirror endpoint if you can't reach huggingface.co at all.

modelMissing.title: Missing model
modelMissing.body: Run the setup command to install the local model.

separatorMissing.title: Separator missing
separatorMissing.body: Disable backing creation to continue, or run the setup command to install it.

ffmpegMissing.title: ffmpeg missing
ffmpegMissing.body: Run the setup command to install ffmpeg.

ytdlpMissing.title: yt-dlp missing
ytdlpMissing.body: Run the setup command to update yt-dlp.

diskFull.title: Disk full
diskFull.body: Free some space or pick a different output folder, then retry.

unknown.title: Job failed
unknown.body: Copy the log to investigate what went wrong.

separationSkipped.title: Backing creation skipped
separationSkipped.body: Continuing with the original audio so subtitles can still be produced. Disable backing creation in Advanced, install the separator, or copy the log to investigate.

notify.successBody: Download, transcription and subtitles are ready.
